note: Level decode coverage measured against the UEShedBuildFixture commandlet, which records the property tags Unreal's own tagged-property serializer emits for each loaded object. The parser decodes every tag that is actually on disk, so undecodedByClass is empty. Regenerate with: pnpm test:uasset-conformance.
postLoadMutatedNote: Not a parser gap: these tags are absent from the saved package but present when the editor re-serializes the loaded object. UMaterialInstance::InitStaticPermutation calls UpdateOverridableBaseProperties, which copies the parent material's values into BasePropertyOverrides for every bOverride_* that is false, so the in-memory struct diverges from its archetype after load even though nothing was written. Proof that it is not on disk: `uasset scan --name BasePropertyOverrides` does not select this level, and a tagged property's name must appear in the package name table. Nothing in the parser can recover a property the package does not contain.
